verdicts.why: In S1 Roger Dooley is the chief and Thompson is Peggy's fellow agent who belittles her; he is only left in charge briefly while Dooley is in Nuremberg and becomes chief after Dooley dies, so boss is wrong for this stage and rival fits (stage 1 at S1#5 has the same issue).

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#6
value.text: May hands the captured Hydra agents behind the UN attack over to Talbot, who greets her with respect and offers his condolences for her fallen agents.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Agent who hands Talbot the Hydra agents behind the UN attack.
value.on_b_card_about_a: General who offers May condolences for her fallen agents.

verdicts.why: In A Fractured House May contacts Talbot to hand over Scarlotti's Hydra team and he speaks to her with respect and offers condolences; Talbot then works with the team through S3 until he turns in S5, a clear rival-to-ally turn with no stage.
Cleary runs the whole Damage Control operation against Simon through Trevor, and it has huge consequences for Simon even without a face-to-face scene; under the implied-ties rule the tie stays.

Andre snatches Mina into his Dark Dimension trance to feed on her emotions, and she then helps restrain him so Tandy can stab him; his power acts on her directly and they deal with each other, so it is not a shared battle only.
The show says it on screen: in the last episode Karnak tells the revived Gorgon, 'It's me, Karnak, your cousin. We're friends. Allies. We're family!'
Venom Returns (#37) only brings the symbiote back; Dormammu and Mordo turn Cletus Kasady into Carnage in Carnage (#38), and a stage can't sit earlier than what its text says has happened.
In S2#22 Coulson talks Cal down, Cal agrees to help stop Jiaying, and Simmons counteracts his formula and reverses his physical changes while he joins the mission: a clear enemy-to-ally turn.

In S2E9 (#19) Alex meets AWOL at Tamar's house and they strike a deal for AWOL to turn on Flores, but AWOL double-crosses him, goes to PRIDE, kills Flores and abducts Livvie; a betrayal between the #18 and #20 stages.

Pietro's main through-line with Tony is his hatred over the Stark shell; he turns against Ultron, not toward Tony, and the existing text and card lines already record his death on Tony's side. Enemy is not clearly wrong, so it passes.
Wikipedia's summary of S1#9 says Murdock, Page, Nelson and Urich begin searching for something from Fisk's past to use against him, so the current text is supported and the change is a rewording.
In #2 Shang-Chi's group, with Katy, arrives at Zemo's Raft along with Kamala's group and they agree to work together; Namor's attack sinks the Raft only afterwards.

value.title: X-Men: First Class
value.text: Charles and Erik try to recruit Logan in a bar, and he brushes them off.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A mutant who brushes off Charles's offer in a bar.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A telepath whose offer Logan brushes off in a bar.

verdicts.why: The two first deal with each other in the First Class bar scene, which the Days of Future Past stage already refers to; a connection that clearly starts in an earlier title gets a stage there (rival chosen for the rebuff, since none of the kinds is an exact fit).

In Night of the Lizard (#1) Debra is already at Connors's ESU lab with Peter, puts on a lab coat there and recognizes Connors's voice; #26 (Shriek of the Vulture) has nothing between them, so the connection starts at #1.
In S2E3 Darius lies to Alex about a run, blocks him from fleeing and hands him to Geoffrey for the deed, then dies the same night; the title ends on that betrayal, so the kind changes there.
Zeus sends Hercules to hunt and kill Thor after Thor names him as a recruit; that active targeting implies a tie, and the rule says not to drop a tie you are unsure about.

Aisha dies in 1947, decades before Muneeba is born, and Muneeba only knows about her; the owner's rule says a blood tie never met stays out, and the Echo vision exception doesn't apply since Muneeba never sees her.

Yelena says Eleanor hired her to kill Clint and Valentina is the one who handed Yelena that job, so the client-and-broker tie is implied on screen and the text says that; the reword is only a style change.

Kraglin and Yondu agree it was a good thing they never delivered Quill as they leave Xandar at the end of Guardians of the Galaxy (2014), not in Vol. 2, so the Vol. 2 stage text puts that moment in the wrong title.
Pietro dies in Sokovia before Tommy exists, and the 'Pietro' in Westview is Ralph Bohner (a separate file); a blood tie never met stays out under the owner's rule.

In S1#2 at the 2050 Haven Hills Roxxcart, the Variant possesses Hunter B-15 and leads Loki through the store through her, before jumping to an employee; they first meet as enemies there, before the S1#4 ally turn.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#16
value.text: Victoria Hand and John Garrett work together on the hunt for the Clairvoyant. Hand shoots down Garrett's defense of the plan and tells him not to call her Vic.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A senior agent who dismisses the Clairvoyant plan Garrett defends.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A veteran agent whose defense of the Clairvoyant plan Hand shoots down.

verdicts.why: The S1#16 stage is real (Hand is briefed with Garrett, then rejects his defense of the plan and his calling her Vic), but the plan is Coulson's team plan that Garrett defends, not Garrett's own plan, so the text and card lines are corrected.

Fitz as Hydra's Doctor rejecting Radcliffe's appeal, killing Kitsworth and imprisoning Radcliffe happens in S4#17 (Identity and Change); a season-wide S4 title puts the stage before S4#1 and before the Aida and betrayal events its card lines describe.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#20
value.text: Radcliffe helps Fitz hunt Jemma in the Framework, then overpowers him and sends him back to the real world, regretting everything he has done.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The friend Radcliffe overpowers and sends home from the Framework.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Fitz's old friend, who overpowers him and sends him home from the Framework.

verdicts.why: In Farewell, Cruel World! Radcliffe, regretting all he has done since the Darkhold, overpowers Fitz and sends him and Simmons out of the Framework; a clear enemy-to-ally turn after the S4#11 and S4#17 enemy stages.

value.title: Cloak & Dagger#12
value.text: Tandy finds comfort in Andre, the friendly leader of her support group.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The friendly leader of Tandy's support group.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A girl in Andre's support group who finds comfort in him.

verdicts.why: In S2E2 (White Lines, #12) Tandy finds comfort in the friendly support leader Andre, who spends time with her outside the group; the connection clearly starts there, before the #16 reveal.
